decisions.reason: Given the firm's heavy investment in a printer close to its core coding offer and its continued website presence through 2019, escalation of commitment makes dropping highly unlikely.
The public launch announcement and centrality of this software module to the announced digitalization strategy create strong commitment that sustains persistence.
As a product building directly on the established inkjet coder portfolio with sunk development costs and prior public visibility, the firm will continue to justify and maintain it.
Although less central than hardware, the app was publicly launched as a successor and has incurred development costs, so escalation leads to persistence despite its lower profile.
Inline verification is central to the announced end-to-end traceability direction, and the firm's prior public commitment makes dropping unlikely.
The software was prominently shown on the home page, indicating visible commitment, and it supports the firm's digitalization push, so escalation favors keeping it.
